scope: Release-note features beyond property-name delta coverage. Complements routeros-7.25-api.json; not a catalog of all historical RouterOS functionality.

features.limits: Numeric and named driver variants preserved. Physical radio behavior unverified.

features.validation: TestAppYAML; TestAppLifecycle; TestAccApp7251; TestAccApp7251Deployment (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Container package/device mode and configured App storage/networking required. YAML retains service privileged and networkRouterIP placeholders.

features.validation: TestAppActionLifecycle; TestAppActionPlanning; TestAccApp7251Deployment (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Operations are explicit, asynchronous, and irreversible where applicable. Refresh/delete never execute an action.

features.validation: Inspected official 7.25 CLI reference and live x86 IoT package 7.25.1: root set, advertisers set, scanners set and peripheral-devices set have no power argument.
features.limits: Requires Bluetooth-capable hardware to establish argument name, range, capability conditions and readback. No guessed attribute is exposed.
